description: Get a single feedback item with its full reply thread. Returns the item's text body (for recordings: the AI-organized feedback), tags (by name), author, posted_by_agent, video timestamp, the recording (recording_type voice, camera or screen; its full verbatim transcript; pipeline_status - the transcript is final once it is complete), visual_references (the pointing phrases - "this", "over here" - with the recording time each was spoken; feed them to get_frame to see what was being pointed at), visuals (images / has_drawing - render them with get_annotated_frames), and all replies (each with reply_to = this item's id). content is Markdown: [0:26](#t=26) links a moment of the video (S in #t=S is video seconds, a range is #t=S,E), and [this](#rt=15.7) marks a phrase spoken at recording time 15.7s (the same values as recording.visual_references, usable as get_frame at).
name: feedback_get
title: Get feedback
